html: Daily: what does the user do today, how often?
Weekly / monthly: which rhythm is already set?
What's used today: tools, exports, spreadsheets, ad-hoc.
"When I …, I want to … so that …"
Who is the primary user themselves? Skill level, tools they already work with, language/jargon.
Who does the user share or discuss this with? Manager, peers, clients — and in what setting?
Which process or decision does this support? Where in the week/month does it recur?
Which (hidden) questions is the user trying to answer? Write them as sentences, not as KPIs.
What do we already have? Existing systems, data models, capacity.
Which data is needed? Sources, quality, frequency, owner.
Which rules/logic? Definitions, business rules, edge cases.
How do we measure success? Tie back to the criteria from the Translate phase.
Describe the chosen form in one sentence — why does it fit this particular user?
Where does it become available? Standard reporting spot or a separate place — and why?
Who is the owner? How does it land in the work rhythm? Demo, training, documentation, maintenance, feedback.

qai.q: Example question — what must the user concretely be able to do?
qai.i: Insight — what stands out? An assumption we need to validate?

actions.title: Concretely — what do we validate next session?
